evidence.quote: expects it will be appropriate to maintain this target range until labor market conditions have reached levels consistent with the Committee's assessments of maximum employment and inflation has risen to 2 percent and is on track to moderately exceed 2 percent for some time
Nevertheless, inflation remained subdued, and participants still generally judged that the overall effect of the pandemic on prices was disinflationary.
Participants judged, however, that the labor market was a long way from being fully recovered.
Participants cited several downside risks that could threaten the recovery.
the Federal Reserve will increase its holdings of Treasury securities and agency mortgage-backed securities at least at the current pace

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe adopting strong outcome-based guidance to keep rates at the ELB until maximum employment is reached and inflation is on track to overshoot 2 percent, alongside continued asset purchases and downside risk emphasis. The recovery was faster than expected and some participants dissented hawkishly, but the net signal is strongly dovish.
